name: ZAN! ~Ryoujoku no Yakata~
source:
Kanzaki Saori's father ran a small town factory, but due to the recession, the company went bankrupt and had a large amount of debt. Her mother also suffers from a serious illness. Then a creditor makes Saori an offer.

Saori will be admitted to the private Tenma Gakuen, a girl's school in a dormitory system, as a tuition fee exempt student, and will introduce a part-time job for debt repayment. Saori takes the offer and performs the transfer procedure. In late July, the last day of a semester, she will transfer, and will go to the villa of the director Narusawa near the school for "the part-time job".

The villa of Narusawa, located on the Midorizawa Kogen, surrounded by mountains, forests and lakes, is a wonderful environment surrounded by dazzling greens, birds singing, and nothing more. However, the excitement did not last long. In the evening of the day Saori arrived at the villa, she's  informed of the astonishing truth from Shiho of the underwriter: "You will work in a membership-only secret club and sexually serve rich men."

Saori, who thought that she would work as a housekeeper, cries and cries out in this too harsh reality. But after all, Saori is determined to "dedicate her body" to save her family.

Saori's days of hell began...
translation:
神崎沙织的父亲经营着一家小镇工厂，但由于经济衰退，公司破产并负债累累。她的母亲也患有重病。然后债权人向Saori提出要约。

沙织将作为免学费学生入读私立天满学园（宿舍制女子学校），并介绍一份兼职工作以偿还债务。Saori接受报价并办理转会手续。7月下旬，一个学期的最后一天，她将转校，前往学校附近鸣泽导演的别墅“打工”。

鸣泽别墅位于绿泽高原上，周围群山环抱，森林湖泊环绕，绿树成荫，鸟语花香，环境优美。然而，兴奋并没有持续多久。纱织抵达别墅的当天晚上，就从承销商志保那里得知了惊人的真相：“你将在会员制秘密俱乐部工作，为有钱人提供性服务。”

本以为自己会成为一名管家的沙织，在这过于严酷的现实中哭了又哭。但纱织毕竟决心“奉献自己的身体”来拯救家人。

纱织的地狱日子开始了……
